people.name: Robert F. Furchgott
people.title: Pharmacologist, Nobel Laureate (1998)
people.known_for: Discovery of endothelium-derived relaxing factor (EDRF), later identified as NO

people.name: Ferid Murad
people.title: Physician, Nobel Laureate (1998)
people.known_for: Showed that nitrovasodilators act via cGMP — link nitrates to NO signaling

people.name: Nathan S. Bryan
people.title: Biochemist, NO researcher

people.known_for: Nitrate-nitrite-NO biochemistry; oral microbiome nitrate reduction; dietary NO restoration

people.name: Jon O. Lundberg
people.title: Professor of Pharmacology

people.name: Eddie Weitzberg
people.title: Professor of Anesthesiology & Intensive Care

people.name: Andrew J. Webb
people.title: Clinical Pharmacologist

people.name: Peter Attia
people.title: Physician, longevity author

people.name: Thomas Dayspring
people.title: Lipidologist, Clinical Professor

people.name: Elizabeth H. Jeffery
people.title: Professor Emerita of Nutrition

people.name: Frans Sacks

people.name: Lawrence T. Goodnough
people.title: Professor of Pathology & Medicine

people.name: Carol J. Boushey
people.title: Researcher

molecules.name: Nitric Oxide (NO)
molecules.label_th: ไนตริกออกไซด์
molecules.role: Endothelium-derived vasodilator; half-life ~2 s; activates sGC → cGMP → smooth muscle relaxation; central player in erection, BP, platelet inhibition

molecules.name: Endothelial NO Synthase (eNOS / NOS3)
molecules.label_th: อีโนส
molecules.role: Uses L-arginine + O2 + NADPH + BH4 → L-citrulline + NO in endothelial cells; shear-stress + agonist activated

molecules.name: L-Arginine
molecules.label_th: แอล-อาร์จินีน
molecules.role: Substrate for eNOS; oral bioavailability ~50% (first-pass arginase); ~5-9 g/day needed to raise plasma levels meaningfully

molecules.name: L-Citrulline
molecules.label_th: แอล-ซิทรูลีน
molecules.role: Bypasses hepatic arginase; converted to arginine in kidney → raises plasma arginine more reliably than oral arginine itself

molecules.name: Tetrahydrobiopterin (BH4)
molecules.label_th: BH4
molecules.role: Essential eNOS cofactor — when oxidized/depleted eNOS 'uncouples' producing superoxide instead of NO (endothelial dysfunction)

molecules.name: Soluble Guanylate Cyclase / cGMP
molecules.label_th: sGC / cGMP
molecules.role: NO activates sGC → raises cGMP → activates PKG → vascular smooth muscle relaxation (target of PDE5 inhibitors like sildenafil)

molecules.name: Dietary Nitrate (NO3-)
molecules.label_th: ไนเตรตจากอาหาร
molecules.role: Concentrated in leafy greens, beetroot; reduced to nitrite by oral bacteria, then to NO in acidic/hypoxic tissue — alternative to eNOS pathway

molecules.name: Nitrite (NO2-)
molecules.label_th: ไนไตรต์
molecules.role: Intermediate between nitrate and NO; formed by oral nitrate-reducing bacteria; reduced further in stomach/vasculature to NO

molecules.name: Hepcidin
molecules.label_th: เฮปซิดิน
molecules.role: Master iron regulator — binds ferroportin causing its degradation → blocks iron export from enterocytes/macrophages; elevated by inflammation (IL-6)

molecules.name: Ferroportin
molecules.label_th: เฟอร์โรพอร์ติน
molecules.role: Only known cellular iron exporter; on basolateral enterocyte + macrophage surface; target of hepcidin

molecules.name: Ferritin
molecules.label_th: เฟอร์ริติน
molecules.role: Intracellular iron storage (up to 4,500 Fe atoms/shell); serum ferritin reflects body iron stores BUT also rises in inflammation/liver damage

molecules.name: Transferrin
molecules.label_th: ทรานสเฟอร์ริน
molecules.role: Iron transport in blood; saturation (TSAT) = serum iron / TIBC × 100; TSAT >45% suggests iron overload

molecules.name: Hemoglobin
molecules.label_th: ฮีโมโกลบิน
molecules.role: Oxygen carrier in erythrocytes; heme iron binds O2 reversibly; low Hb = anemia

molecules.name: Apolipoprotein B-100
molecules.label_th: เอโพบี-100
molecules.role: Single ApoB-100 per VLDL / IDL / LDL / Lp(a) particle → ApoB = atherogenic particle count; produced in liver

molecules.name: Apolipoprotein A1
molecules.label_th: เอโพเอวัน
molecules.role: Main protein of HDL; ApoB/ApoA1 ratio = robust CVD predictor (INTERHEART)

molecules.name: Homocysteine (Hcy)
molecules.label_th: โฮโมซิสเทอีน
molecules.role: Intermediate in methionine metabolism; accumulates with B12/folate/B6 deficiency or MTHFR variants; elevated Hcy → endothelial damage

molecules.name: 5-Methyl-tetrahydrofolate (5-MTHF)
molecules.label_th: เมธิลโฟเลต
molecules.role: Active folate form; methyl donor to B12 in remethylation of Hcy to methionine; bypasses MTHFR bottleneck

molecules.name: Methylcobalamin (methyl-B12)
molecules.label_th: เมธิลโคบาลามิน
molecules.role: Active cytoplasmic B12 form; required as cofactor for methionine synthase to remethylate Hcy

molecules.name: Niacin (Vitamin B3)
molecules.label_th: ไนอะซิน / B3
molecules.role: At high dose (1-3 g/d) lowers LDL/TG, raises HDL, reduces Lp(a); causes flush via GPR109A → prostaglandin D2

molecules.name: Coenzyme Q10 (Ubiquinol/Ubiquinone)
molecules.label_th: โคคิวเท็น
molecules.role: Mitochondrial electron transport; depleted by statins (shared HMG-CoA pathway); ubiquinol is the reduced active form

molecules.name: Vitamin K2 (menaquinone-7, MK-7)
molecules.label_th: วิตามิน K2
molecules.role: Activates matrix Gla protein (MGP) and osteocalcin → keeps calcium out of arteries and into bones; half-life ~72 h (vs MK-4 ~1 h)

molecules.name: Pycnogenol (French Maritime Pine Bark Extract)
molecules.label_th: ไพคโนจินอล
molecules.role: Upregulates eNOS; scavenges ROS; clinical trials show improved FMD and modest BP reduction

molecules.name: Cocoa Flavanol (epicatechin)
molecules.label_th: ฟลาวานอลโกโก้
molecules.role: Improves FMD within hours; increases eNOS activity; dose ~200-500 mg flavanols

organizations.name: NIH / National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute

case_studies.name: Webb Beetroot BP Study
case_studies.claim_to_fame: 500 mL beetroot juice in healthy volunteers → SBP drop ~10.4 mmHg peaking at 2.5 h (Hypertension / BMJ 2008)

case_studies.name: DASH Diet Trial
case_studies.claim_to_fame: DASH diet (fruits/veg/low-fat dairy) reduced SBP 11.4 mmHg in hypertensives vs control at 8 weeks — landmark NEJM

case_studies.name: Lundberg Nitrate-Nitrite-NO Pathway
case_studies.claim_to_fame: Nature Reviews Drug Discovery review establishing enterosalivary circulation of nitrate → nitrite → NO as clinically relevant alternative to eNOS
case_studies.source: Lundberg JO, Weitzberg E, Gladwin MT. Nat Rev Drug Discov 2008; 7:156-167

case_studies.name: Boushey 1995 Hcy Meta-Analysis
case_studies.claim_to_fame: Meta-analysis in JAMA establishing 10% SBP/coronary-disease excess risk per 5 μmol/L Hcy increase; helped frame homocysteine as modifiable CVD risk

case_studies.name: Sniderman ApoB JAMA Cardiol 2019
case_studies.claim_to_fame: Meta-analysis + Mendelian randomization showing ApoB is single best atherogenic-lipoprotein marker, superior to LDL-C and non-HDL-C
case_studies.source: Sniderman AD et al., JAMA Cardiol 2019; 4:1287-1295

case_studies.name: Heiss Cocoa Flavanol FMD Study
case_studies.claim_to_fame: Cocoa flavanol beverage acutely increased FMD and circulating nitric oxide metabolites within 2 h (JACC 2005)

case_studies.name: Ignarro / Furchgott / Murad NO Nobel
case_studies.claim_to_fame: 1998 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine for the discovery that NO is a signaling molecule in the cardiovascular system

case_studies.name: Kapil Mouthwash-BP Study
case_studies.claim_to_fame: Antibacterial mouthwash for 7 days raised resting SBP ~3.5 mmHg by killing oral nitrate-reducing bacteria (Free Radic Biol Med 2013)
case_studies.source: Kapil V et al., Free Radic Biol Med 2013; 55:93-100

case_studies.name: Figueroa L-Citrulline Meta-Analysis
case_studies.claim_to_fame: Pooled analysis of L-citrulline/watermelon supplementation showing ~7/4 mmHg SBP/DBP reductions in pre-hypertensives
case_studies.source: Figueroa A et al., Nutr Rev 2017; 75:907-914

case_studies.name: Rotterdam Study Vitamin K2 / CVD
case_studies.claim_to_fame: Highest tertile of dietary K2 intake associated with 57% lower CVD mortality + less aortic calcification (Geleijnse J Nutr 2004)
case_studies.source: Geleijnse JM et al., J Nutr 2004; 134:3100-3105
